description: This Java class defines a ChainAuthHandler that manages a chain of authentication handlers to authenticate a given execution context by attempting each handler in sequence until one successfully extracts credentials or all have failed.

classes.name: ChainAuthHandler
classes.description: A handler that maintains a chain of other AuthHandler instances to authenticate an ExecutionContext by sequentially invoking each handler until one succeeds or all fail. Supports appending handlers dynamically.

methods.name: ChainAuthHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes an empty chain of auth handlers.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Adds a new AuthHandler to the chain for future credential parsing attempts.

methods.name: parseCredentials
methods.description: Starts the process of parsing credentials from the context by sequentially invoking each handler in the chain.
